# CANDIDATE: TBR_HIGH_VOL_VALIDATION_STAGE4

**Filed:** 2026-07-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** watcher_proposal
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that the TBR_HIGH_VOL strategy (TRENDLINE_BREAK_RETEST with vol >= 1.5x 20-bar avg) has a positive edge_capture on the OP-16 anchor days and improves wide_pnl without regressing on the 4/29 and 5/04 winners, when validated with walk-forward analysis and real-fills simulation using simulator_real.py.

## Mechanism

The TBR_HIGH_VOL strategy is a watcher-only trade class that fires when:
- A TRENDLINE_BREAK_RETEST setup occurs (as defined in the existing watcher)
- The volume on the breakout bar is at least 1.5 times the 20-bar average volume.
We will run walk-forward analysis (using the existing walk-forward test) and real-fills simulation (using simulator_real.py) on the OP-16 anchor days and the full OOS window to compute edge_capture and wide_pnl.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline
2. **Sample bias:** The TBR_HIGH_VOL strategy has been tested on IS window (N=332) and OOS window (N=239) as per the existing WF PASS. However, the sample may be biased due to concentration (IS Q2-2025=85.4% of P&L from top 5 days, OOS Q1-2026=90.6% of P&L from top 5 days). Overfit risk is high due to concentration.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward analysis to be performed as part of validation)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real-fills simulation using simulator_real.py to be performed as part of validation)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Large losses on days when volume filter fails to capture true breakout or retest fails.
   - Max drawdown: To be determined from walk-forward and real-fills.
   - Blow-up scenario: Regime shift where high-volume breakouts fail consistently.
6. **Concentration:** Existing candidate shows concentration flag: IS Q2-2025=85.4% + OOS Q1-2026=90.6% (both >80% gate). Top-5 days % to be computed from validation.

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators pass for strategy logic
- Walk-forward analysis with OOS/IS ratio >= 0.70
- Real-fills simulation on top 3 J days showing no regression (engine takes winners, avoids/minimizes losses on losers)
- No regression on 4/29 and 5/04 wins (strategy captures at least same P&L as current engine on these days)

## Confidence

5 / 10 -- The strategy has shown promise in walk-forward (ratio=0.866) but suffers from severe concentration and ATM real-fills failure. Validation with real-fills simulation and anchor day regression check needed.
